plain_english: In varied beginningness, in melted rule: what taste — from partitionlessness, supreme fullness unequalled? The self's yoking of lights, all-being-thing-oneness, by unopposed dharma-floods: supreme knowing, priceless-fit-qualified.
sanskrit_cite: vicitrārambhatve galitaniyame yaḥ kila rasaḥ | sakalabhavabhāvaikamayatāviruddhair dharmaughaiḥ paracitir anarghocitaguṇā
